title: Remove four guide lines that disagree with the owner files
summary: A read of every guide against the owner files found four lines that the repository contradicts. AGENTS listed the Stage 2 requirements as direction, transition, stop, torque, contact and visual acceptance; the judged rows of configs/accepted_controller.json are commands, stopping distance, drift, stop tolerance, tilt and motor torque, and the guide's Outcome paragraph already cites that file, so the sentence is removed. The locomotion guide said that the 56 bound runtime files match main; the approval lapses when this branch merges, so the guide now points to the site check that reports it. The same guide listed scoring under the evaluation package, where the requirements judge replaced the scorer. The capability issue template asked for R/Q requirement numbers in ARCHITECTURE, which holds none; it now asks for the owner file and the roadmap step.
next: Decide the open points of the documentation audit: the page headline, the issue 20 text and the Stage 2 definition copies.
reason: Four guide lines change to match the owner files and the code. No code, result or gate changes.
